projects.title: Dockerize a Full‑Stack Web App 🏗️
projects.description: Build Dockerfiles for a Node.js backend, React frontend, and MongoDB database. Use Docker Compose to orchestrate services, volumes for data persistence, and custom networks for isolation.

projects.title: Secure CI/CD Pipeline for Docker Images 🔁
projects.description: Create a local CI/CD pipeline script that builds a multi‑stage image, runs tests, scans for vulnerabilities, and pushes to Docker Hub – all automated.

projects.title: Production Swarm Stack with Secrets & Monitoring 🐝
projects.description: Deploy a full‑stack application to a Docker Swarm cluster using stacks, overlay networks, secrets, and resource limits. Implement health checks and rolling updates.
